job_spec.name: qfd_vm_xcol_t-xc1-d6fcb8405
job_spec.purpose: Qwen TP8 VM bit-plane column leaf (32 per die, one row in the x band): ot_qfd_vm_xplane_t (pin flop, rot1, rot2, bv) + ot_qfd_vm_xline_t (line, x_q replication) of ONE bit position in one leaf, so the 1,008-b bv plane is leaf wiring and the lanes land on both faces (d_lo S, d_hi N; x_q plane on W / E). ~9.7k flops, one root. Supersedes qfd_vm_xplane_t (closed xp1) and the size-only qfd_vm_xline_t. Bench = xcol leaf miter (merged leaf vs its two parts) + 3 plane and 3 line mutants; the parts carry their own miters against the parent (records results/rtl/qwen_tp8_vm_plane_20261013).
